title: J&J Show: Stakes raised for Memphis' Silverfield in 2025 - NewsBreak
text: Jason & John discussed the expecations for Ryan Silverfield's 2025 Memphis Tigers Football team and the mixed legacy of Silverfield as the coach with Daily Memphian Memphis Tigers Football Beat Writer Frank Bonner. AUDIO: As Ryan Silverfield enters the 2025 season as Memphis Tigers head coach, expectations are high—but far from unanimous. After guiding Memphis to consistent bowl appearances and solid records, Silverfield has shown stability. Yet, critics argue he hasn’t elevated the program since inheriting it from Mike Norvell. With the College Football Playoff expanding and the AAC's national profile evolving, some fans expect Silverfield to deliver a conference title or New Year’s Six berth, not just bowl eligibility. Complicating his legacy are mixed signals: his teams win, but rarely in dominant fashion; his recruiting is steady, but not game-changing. Some view him as a steady hand maintaining relevance, while others see a coach who’s plateaued. The 2025 season could define his tenure—either affirming him as the right long-term leader or amplifying calls for change if Memphis underwhelms.
